D: A bunch of misfits sign up for the police academy.
P: Serve the mains when the cadets end up at the Blue Oyster bar.
S: Golden skillet cornbread with butter, cut in wedges.
Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, buttermilk, eggs and melted butter, pour into a hot buttered cast iron pan, bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
Chicken, egg noodles, carrot and celery in a clear broth, ladled hot.

Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a little oil. Add the stock and chicken and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Lift it out and shred. Add the noodles and simmer until tender. Return the chicken, season and scatter with parsley.
M: Beef and pork meatloaf under a sticky tomato glaze, sliced thick.
Beef and pork mince with breadcrumbs, egg, onion and Worcestershire, shaped in a tin, glazed with tomato sauce and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour. Mash.
Breaded chicken with tomato and cheese.

Crumbed chicken breast under napoli and melted mozzarella, with chips and a rocket salad. Simmer the tomatoes with the crushed garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes until thick. Slice each breast in half through the middle and flatten. Dip in flour, then beaten egg, then panko. Bake the chips at 220C for 25 minutes. Shallow fry the chicken in the vegetable oil for 3 minutes a side until golden. Spoon the napoli over the chicken, cover with mozzarella and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling. Dress the rocket with the olive oil and lemon and serve with the parmigiana and chips.
W: Vanilla slab cake with buttercream and a blue badge, for the bravery awards.
Vanilla slab cake with buttercream, piped with a police badge and “Graduates” in blue icing.
K: Fresh lemonade tinted blue, over ice with a lemon wheel and a cherry.
Juice 5 lemons and stir with the sugar until it dissolves. Add the cold water and colouring. Pour over ice with a wheel of the last lemon and a cherry.

steps.text: Grease a cast iron pan with the butter and heat it in a 200C oven.
Whisk the cornmeal, plain flour, caster sugar and baking powder with the buttermilk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour into the hot pan and bake.
Serve warm with butter.

steps.text: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg, grated onion and Worcestershire.
Press into a loaf tin and glaze with tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C.
Boil the potatoes while the meatloaf bakes.
Rest the meatloaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.

steps.text: Grate the onion and fry with the mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the mushrooms, breadcrumbs, eggs and soy sauce.
Press into a lined loaf tin and glaze with the tomato sauce mixed with brown sugar.
Bake at 180C until firm. Boil the potatoes while it bakes.
Rest the loaf, mash the potatoes with butter and milk and serve thick slices.

veg.make_ahead: Crumb the eggplant and make the napoli up to 1 day ahead in the fridge

steps.text: Simmer the tomatoes with the crushed garlic, oregano and a pinch of salt for 10 minutes until thick.
Slice the eggplants into thick rounds, salt them, then dip in flour, beaten egg and panko.
Bake the chips at 220C for 25 minutes.
Shallow fry the eggplant in the vegetable oil for 3 minutes a side until golden and soft.
Spoon the napoli over, cover with mozzarella and grill for 5 minutes until bubbling.
Dress the rocket with the olive oil and lemon and serve with the parmigiana and chips.
Heat the oven to 175C and line a slab tin. Beat the butter and sugar, add the eggs, then fold in the flour and milk.
Bake.
Cool the cake completely.
Beat the butter with the icing sugar and tint blue.
Spread on the cake.
Pipe a badge and the word Graduates in blue.

Mess hall meatloaf.veg: Lentil and mushroom loaf with a tomato glaze.

Hightower's chicken parmigiana.veg: Breaded eggplant under marinara and melted mozzarella, with fries and an arugula salad.

Mess hall chicken noodle soup.veg: Use vegetable stock and swap the chicken for white beans.

s.note: Golden skillet cornbread with butter, cut in wedges.
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 200C oven. Whisk 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 2 eggs and 60g melted butter. Pour into the hot pan and bake 20 minutes. Serve warm with butter.

s.note: Chicken, egg noodles, carrot and celery in a clear broth, ladled hot.
s.how: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a little oil. Add the stock and chicken and simmer until the chicken is cooked. Lift it out and shred. Add the noodles and simmer until tender. Return the chicken, season and scatter with parsley.

m.note: Beef and pork meatloaf under a sticky tomato glaze, sliced thick.
m.how: Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 1 grated onion and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Press into a loaf tin, glaze with 80ml tomato sauce mixed with 1 tbsp brown sugar, bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Serve thick slices with 1kg potatoes mashed with butter and milk.

w.note: Vanilla slab cake with buttercream and a blue badge, for the bravery awards.
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 200g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake in a slab tin at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 200g butter with 350g icing sugar, spread on and pipe a badge and Graduates in blue.

d.note: Fresh lemonade tinted blue, over ice with a lemon wheel and a cherry.
d.how: Juice 5 lemons and stir with the sugar until it dissolves. Add the cold water and colouring. Pour over ice with a wheel of the last lemon and a cherry.
